title: Cosmic Braided Muse
description: A surreal black and white portrait of a woman with a long intricate braid, her right face covered in a vibrant mosaic of colorful geometric triangles containing symbols and a red eye. In the background, a lavender field stretches toward mountains under a starry sky filled with geometric constellations, while a spherical orb contains a smaller face and a tiny explorer figure stands on the braid.
